caption:
A smarter way to job hunt

Why choose Fortune Jobs AI for your job search? Real U.S. jobs straight from employer career sites, a free ATS résumé score, AI job search in plain English, fit estimates before you apply and an AI interview coach. All free, and your résumé stays private. Start your search today.

👉 Free at fortunejobsai.com (link in bio)

#jobsearch2026 #findajob #careerchange #jobsearch #newgrad

Free ATS résumé score

Most big companies run your résumé through an ATS before a person sees it. Upload yours on Fortune Jobs AI and get a free ATS readiness score with clear fixes. Your file never leaves your browser.

👉 Free at fortunejobsai.com (link in bio)

#atsresume #resumecheck #jobsearch #careeradvice #hiring

Skip the middleman

Tired of job boards that send you through five other sites? On Fortune Jobs AI most jobs come straight from the company's own careers page, so Apply takes you right to the employer.

👉 Free at fortunejobsai.com (link in bio)

#applydirect #jobboard #jobsearch #careeradvice #hiring

Search the way you talk

No more fiddling with ten filters. Type the job you want in plain English, like "remote Power BI jobs in New Jersey posted this week", and our AI search does the rest.

👉 Free at fortunejobsai.com (link in bio)

#ai #aitools #jobsearch #careeradvice #hiring

Is your résumé missing keywords?

Recruiters search the ATS by keywords from the job ad. Paste a job description into our free checker to see which keywords your résumé already has and which are missing.

👉 Free at fortunejobsai.com (link in bio)

#resumekeywords #jobtips #jobsearch #careeradvice #hiring

Build an ATS-friendly résumé free

Fancy templates with columns and icons often confuse ATS software. Our free résumé builder uses a clean layout recruiters and ATS systems read easily, with a live score as you type.

👉 Free at fortunejobsai.com (link in bio)

#resumebuilder #freeresume #jobsearch #careeradvice #hiring

Practice the interview

Found a job you like? Open it on Fortune Jobs AI and tap Practice interview questions. Our AI coach writes questions for that exact role so you walk in ready.

👉 Free at fortunejobsai.com (link in bio)

#interviewtips #interviewprep #jobsearch #careeradvice #hiring

Start lines with a verb

Résumé tip: replace "Responsible for…" with what you actually did. "Built", "Reduced", "Led" and "Automated" show impact. Our free ATS check flags the weak lines for you.

👉 Free at fortunejobsai.com (link in bio)

#resumetip #careertips #jobsearch #careeradvice #hiring

Numbers get interviews

Résumé tip: numbers make achievements real. Add results you can verify, like time saved, users supported or money managed. Our ATS score rewards measurable results.

👉 Free at fortunejobsai.com (link in bio)

#resumetip #jobseekers #jobsearch #careeradvice #hiring
